operations: Inspect topic suggestions; accept/decline suggestions with current GraphQL mutations
capabilities.verification: Read repository again, inspect owner/name/visibility/default branch and feature flags.
capabilities.limitations: Metadata read for discovery; Administration write and owner/organization policy govern settings. Transfers, visibility changes and deletion require specific authorization; archive is not deletion.

operations: Generate a repository from a template
Choose owner/visibility and include branches where supported
capabilities.verification: Read generated repository and compare expected files and default branch.
capabilities.limitations: Creation rights in destination owner required; template generation is distinct from a fork and does not establish shared Git history.

operations: Fetch upstream and submit cross-repository PRs
capabilities.verification: Read parent/source and compare upstream/fork commit SHAs.
capabilities.limitations: Contents write for synchronization; private/internal fork policy and organization access apply; never force-sync divergent work without authorization.

capabilities.capability: Contents, README, archives and immutable source reads
operations: Create/update/delete file with expected blob SHA
capabilities.verification: Read changed file at returned commit SHA; inspect archive contents and source ref.
capabilities.limitations: Contents read/write; workflow-file edits additionally need Workflows permission. Contents API size/directory limits apply; use Git/trees for large listings and batches; download URLs expire.

capabilities.capability: Git blobs, trees, commits, refs and annotated tags
operations: Batch multiple file changes into one commit
capabilities.verification: Read final ref and commit/tree; compare expected parent SHA and changed paths.
capabilities.limitations: Contents permissions and branch rules apply. Use non-force ref update; preserve unrelated tree entries. Empty repositories need initialization; PR merge refs are not a durable mergeability source.

capabilities.capability: History, compare, blame and commit verification
capabilities.verification: Record base/head SHAs and verify diff against Git checkout.
capabilities.limitations: Contents read; paginated compare/file limits require local Git for complete large diffs. A signature validity result is not a trust decision by itself.

capabilities.verification: Read renamed/updated branch SHA, default branch and affected open PR bases.
capabilities.limitations: Contents write for branch changes; rename/default branch administration can require admin and ruleset bypass. Never infer a branch can be deleted merely because a PR merged.

capabilities.capability: Community standards and shared contribution files
capabilities.verification: Read community profile health/files plus rendered links at the default branch.
capabilities.limitations: Community health is a checklist rather than proof of policy quality; shared default files may supply files absent locally. License and funding choices remain owner decisions.

operations: Configure key prefix and URL pattern
capabilities.verification: Read configured prefix/template and inspect rendered sample reference.
capabilities.limitations: Administration read/write; avoid collisions with current tracker prefixes; autolinks do not synchronize external issue state.

operations: Require owner review through branch rules
capabilities.verification: Query CODEOWNERS errors and inspect reviewer request on a matching PR.
capabilities.limitations: Owners must have write access; team visibility/access and matching order matter. CODEOWNERS alone does not require an approving review; configure enforcement separately.

capabilities.capability: Large files, submodules and checkout fidelity
capabilities.verification: Verify object contents, submodule SHA and file modes in the actual checkout.
capabilities.limitations: Git LFS requires installed client and storage/bandwidth entitlement; a pointer or submodule link is not its file content. Do not execute untrusted submodule hooks or code.

capabilities.verification: Read issue state/state_reason/title/body and timeline.
capabilities.limitations: Issues read/write and actor role apply; REST issue lists also contain PRs, so filter pull_request entries. Closing an issue is separate from merging or deploying a fix.

capabilities.verification: Re-read issue metadata and milestone counters/dates; compare IDs rather than display names alone.
capabilities.limitations: Issues write generally required for management; respect existing names/colors. Set/replace operations remove omitted labels; prefer add/remove for narrow changes.

capabilities.verification: Read final assignees and confirm intended user, not just successful HTTP status.
capabilities.limitations: Issues or Pull requests permissions per endpoint; account/repository eligibility applies. Assignment notifies people and is not proof they accepted work.

operations: Set due date and open/closed state
Assign issues and PRs to milestones
capabilities.verification: Read due_on/state and included open/closed issues and PRs.
capabilities.limitations: Issues write for mutation; milestone is repository-scoped. Deleting or closing a milestone does not finish its open work.

capabilities.capability: Owner issue types and per-issue type assignment
capabilities.verification: Read repository available types and issue type ID/name after assignment.
capabilities.limitations: Repository type discovery needs Metadata read; owner type management has separate Issue Types permissions. Types can belong to organizations or personal accounts; do not hard-code Bug/Task/Feature or confuse type with label.

capabilities.capability: Organization and personal issue type administration
capabilities.verification: List owner definitions and repository inherited enabled types.
capabilities.limitations: Issue Types organization read/write; personal counterpart uses Issue Types user permission and user-scoped token. Changes affect multiple repositories; preserve existing definitions.

operations: Manage single-select options and supported types
Configure pinning/type applicability/visibility in owner settings
capabilities.verification: Read field definitions and inspect visibility and pinned placement on a representative issue.
capabilities.limitations: Issue Fields owner permissions and organization/account ownership required. Issue fields are distinct from Project custom fields; UI and REST supported types can differ by API version, so inspect schema before choosing multi_select.

operations: Reuse owner field and option IDs
capabilities.verification: Read final values from issue endpoint and rendered issue; confirm no unrelated values were replaced.
capabilities.limitations: Issues read/write; field visibility may restrict public values. Add vs set are different operations; user-owned field definitions use /user/issue-fields.

capabilities.capability: Issue forms, templates and contact routing
operations: Maintain Markdown templates and chooser config
capabilities.verification: Open new-issue chooser and render/test each form without submitting unwanted issues.
capabilities.limitations: Contents write and default-branch placement; form YAML schema is constrained and not arbitrary workflow code. Check owner .github defaults before duplicating templates.

capabilities.verification: Read both parent and child relationships and final ordering.
capabilities.limitations: Issues read/write; hierarchy/access/size/depth restrictions apply. Use issue database IDs where endpoint expects them, not issue numbers; removing child relation does not delete the issue.

operations: List issues blocked by this issue
capabilities.verification: Read blocked_by and blocking sides; verify intended direction and no duplicate edge.
capabilities.limitations: Issues read/write and access to linked issues required; dependencies are separate from parent/child and from a Markdown mention. Preserve existing unrelated dependencies.

capabilities.verification: Read accepted relationships or suggestion disposition and linked issue IDs.
capabilities.limitations: Issues permissions and endpoint eligibility apply. Suggestions are proposals, not established dependencies; approve only evidence-backed relationships.

capabilities.capability: Conversation comments, pinned comments and reactions
capabilities.verification: Read comment by ID, rendered body and pinned state; compare author before editing.
capabilities.limitations: Issues or Pull requests permissions per endpoint; edit/delete rights differ for own vs others comments. Comments on PR conversation use issue comments, not review-comment endpoints.

capabilities.verification: Read artifact by ID/number and fetch all pages until an empty page.
capabilities.limitations: Issues or Pull requests permissions; list response has no Link/total pagination metadata. Issue artifacts differ from Actions artifacts and ordinary Markdown attachments; inspect rendered HTML behavior before sharing.

capabilities.capability: Timeline, audit context and cross references
operations: Inspect cross references and linked closing PRs
capabilities.verification: Record event IDs/timestamps and associated commit/PR URLs.
capabilities.limitations: Issues read; pagination and actor visibility apply. A mention or cross-reference does not necessarily establish an auto-closing link.

capabilities.verification: Read new canonical URL and metadata after transfer; inspect duplicate/pinned timeline and repository pin list.
capabilities.limitations: Role/owner/visibility eligibility and feature limits apply. Transfer can alter labels/milestones and links; deletion is destructive. Duplicate marking does not prove the underlying issue is resolved.

capabilities.capability: Issue dashboard and advanced triage views
operations: Build boolean AND/OR/NOT and parenthesized filters
Filter issue types, metadata, dates, blockers and hierarchy where supported
capabilities.verification: Run filter and inspect sampled matching and non-matching issues; verify saved view survives reload.
capabilities.limitations: UI dashboard and global/API search grammars are not identical. Check current qualifiers and API advanced_search support before reusing nested queries verbatim.

capabilities.capability: Pull request lifecycle, drafts and base/head management
capabilities.verification: Read PR head/base SHA, draft/state and complete diff; confirm expected source repository.
capabilities.limitations: Pull requests read/write; Contents and source branch access may also be needed. Diff/file pagination limits matter; mergeable can be temporarily unknown and needs re-query.

operations: Use closing keywords with correct issue reference
capabilities.verification: Read linked issues before merge and actual issue state/timeline after merge.
capabilities.limitations: Closing keywords act when merged into default branch; references to other repositories need correct owner/repo. Mentioning an issue alone is not an auto-closing relationship.

operations: Use body-file with validation evidence and closing reference
capabilities.verification: Preview new PR body and read published PR body.
capabilities.limitations: Contents write to default branch; multiple templates require correct template query. A checked checkbox is not test evidence.

capabilities.verification: Read requested reviewers and review history; verify stale reviews are handled by current rules.
capabilities.limitations: Pull requests write and reviewer eligibility required; authors cannot approve their own PR. Team review request and individual approval are different facts.

capabilities.verification: Read submitted review state, author, commit SHA and dismissal reason.
capabilities.limitations: Pull requests write; dismissal may require elevated role or rules permissions. Review the actual head and connected code; do not approve on behalf of another actor.

capabilities.capability: Inline review comments, suggestions and threads
capabilities.verification: Read comment path/line/side/commit and thread state against current PR diff.
capabilities.limitations: Pull requests read/write; LEFT/RIGHT and start_line must match diff. Resolution is not review dismissal; code suggestions alter code only when applied and committed.

capabilities.capability: Guarded merge and asynchronous merge results
operations: Read merge result and merge commit
capabilities.verification: Read merged=true and merge_commit_sha; inspect base branch commit and issue state.
capabilities.limitations: Contents write and all branch/rules checks required. Pass expected SHA to avoid merging a newly changed head; queued/asynchronous acceptance is not completion.

capabilities.verification: Read autoMergeRequest then final merged state and commit.
capabilities.limitations: Repository maintainer enables capability; PR actor needs write. Public Free or private paid-plan availability applies. Head/base changes or untrusted pushes can disable auto-merge.

operations: Read queue position and failure/removal reason
capabilities.verification: Inspect queue entry and merge_group check run; verify final base commit after dequeue/merge.
capabilities.limitations: Public organization repositories or private organization repositories on Enterprise Cloud; admin config and write enqueue rights. CI must handle merge_group; PR-only passing checks cannot establish queued batch safety.

capabilities.capability: Update branch, revert and branch cleanup
operations: Update PR branch using expected head SHA
capabilities.verification: Read updated head and checks; verify revert tree and retained branches before cleanup.
capabilities.limitations: Contents/PR write and protection rules apply; update is asynchronous. GitHub UI revert may fail on conflicts; revert is a new change requiring validation, not history erasure.

capabilities.verification: Read stack with all PR IDs and compare bases/heads after mutation.
capabilities.limitations: Pull requests read/write and stack eligibility apply; native stacks differ from unrelated branches described as stacked. API exposure does not prove feature enabled on every host/account.

capabilities.capability: Agent Merge enrollment and allowed automation actions
capabilities.verification: Read /agents/repos/OWNER/REPO/pulls/N/agent-merge and inspect actual subsequent PR/check history.
capabilities.limitations: Paid Copilot excluding Free, repository write, Allow automations, no fork or stack for enrollment. Only latest enrolling user changes allowed actions; Agent tasks write remains needed for cleanup. Never enroll as an implicit substitute for ordinary merge.

operations: Require conversations resolved and linear history
capabilities.verification: Read effective protection and test behavior on an authorized disposable branch/PR.
capabilities.limitations: Administration permissions; public Free and private paid-plan availability apply. Classic protection matching differs from cumulative rulesets; inspect both before deciding effective policy.

operations: Inspect inherited rules and bypass actors
capabilities.verification: Read effective branch rules plus source ruleset and enforcement state; inspect rule suites for real outcomes.
capabilities.limitations: Read available to repository readers; admin/custom edit-rules role for writes. Public Free/private paid plans; push rulesets have additional plan/scope restrictions. Bypass and evaluate mode are not enforced compliance.

operations: Diagnose failed pushes and merge requirements
Identify inherited rule source and bypass use
capabilities.verification: Record rule-suite conclusion, actor/ref, evaluated rules and enforcement mode.
capabilities.limitations: Repository access and applicable rules permissions required; rule history retention and plan vary. Do not weaken policy to make a delivery pass.

capabilities.capability: Repository merge methods and branch cleanup policy
operations: Toggle auto-delete branches and update-branch suggestions
capabilities.verification: Read repository merge flags and inspect resulting merge commit/message on an actual PR.
capabilities.limitations: Administration write; merge method must also satisfy branch rules. Default branch or protected branches may not be auto-deleted.

capabilities.capability: Projects v2 discovery, lifecycle and repository links
capabilities.verification: Read Project number/node ID/owner/public/closed/readme and linked repositories.
capabilities.limitations: Project role is separate from repository role. Classic project endpoints are not Projects v2; classic PAT project/read:project scopes or correct fine-grained Projects permissions are needed, plus private repository access for content.

capabilities.verification: Read item ID/content ID/field values/archive state and issue URL after conversion.
capabilities.limitations: Projects read/write and repository content access; not every operation exists in REST. Removing an item is not deleting its issue; a draft is not a repository issue until conversion.

capabilities.capability: Project custom fields and built-in metadata
capabilities.verification: Read field IDs/data types/options and sample item values.
capabilities.limitations: Projects read/write; built-in issue fields are backed by the issue and not arbitrary custom-field values. Options use IDs; do not match a Status field solely by position.

capabilities.capability: Typed Project field values and clearing
operations: Preserve field option IDs and typed GraphQL inputs
capabilities.verification: Read the specific item field value including option/iteration ID after write.
capabilities.limitations: Project write; mutation types differ by field and API. An issue may appear in multiple Projects with different statuses; editing one does not update all.

operations: Assign items and use relative iteration filters
capabilities.verification: Read iteration configuration and item iteration ID; inspect current and next iteration views.
capabilities.limitations: Project write for schedule changes; gh/API support is operation-specific. Changing iteration definitions can affect many items; preserve completed history.

capabilities.capability: Saved table, board and roadmap views
operations: Duplicate/reorder through UI when API unsupported
capabilities.verification: Read view identity/layout/filter with GraphQL and open rendered view; verify persistence on reload.
capabilities.limitations: Projects write; REST documents create while GraphQL exposes createProjectV2View/updateProjectV2View/deleteProjectV2View. visible_fields excludes roadmap and grouping requires eligible fields. GraphQL configuration currently exposes visibleFieldIds; REST creation additionally accepts grouping/sort. Use UI for unsupported controls.

capabilities.capability: Grouping, slicing, sorting and field visibility
capabilities.verification: Inspect rendered table/board/roadmap with representative items and reload saved settings.
capabilities.limitations: Write role to save shared views; available controls differ by layout and field. API support for creation parameters does not imply support for every subsequent layout edit.

capabilities.capability: Project filters and saved-view item retrieval
operations: List REST view items with saved filter applied
Use fields selection for desired values
capabilities.verification: Compare API view item IDs with rendered filtered view and unfiltered project totals.
capabilities.limitations: Projects read and private item access; REST page cursors use Link headers. Title alone can be the default response; explicitly request needed field IDs. Issue search grammar is not Project filter grammar.

operations: Inspect historical trends and burn-up style progress
capabilities.verification: Open saved chart, inspect filters/time range and reconcile plotted totals with source items.
capabilities.limitations: Project write to configure, read to view; plan-dependent chart/history limits. Archived/deleted items are excluded. No chart mutation API verified here; keep explicit UI evidence instead of assuming chart exists from Project fields.

operations: List/get workflow name/enabled state via GraphQL
Enable/disable/configure event transitions and issue-close behavior in UI
capabilities.verification: Read saved workflow configuration; exercise authorized sample event and read resulting field/state.
capabilities.limitations: Project write; not every workflow is enabled by default. Status option names are project-specific; automation can close issues, so treat its effects as writes to repository work.

operations: Inspect scope and matching future issues/PRs
capabilities.verification: Read saved filter/repository and verify a newly matching item appears with its content ID.
capabilities.limitations: Project write and repository visibility; workflow count/plan limits and supported filter qualifiers apply. Built-in auto-add is not a guaranteed historical backfill and templates do not copy auto-add workflows.

capabilities.verification: Read saved workflow and final archived state; check restored item remains visible.
capabilities.limitations: Project write; archiving is not completion or deletion. Charts exclude archived items, so archive policy changes reporting and must be documented.

capabilities.capability: Project automation through Actions and webhooks
operations: Add items and set fields through API
Use installation token with Project access
capabilities.verification: Inspect successful workflow run and read target item state plus idempotent rerun behavior.
capabilities.limitations: Repository GITHUB_TOKEN does not automatically have owner Project access; suitable App/PAT scope required. Do not expose credentials to untrusted PR code or duplicate items after ambiguous failure.

capabilities.verification: Open resulting Project and compare fields/views/drafts/workflows/charts; explicitly inspect missing auto-add rules.
capabilities.limitations: Organization owner/template permissions and project roles apply. Templates omit auto-add workflows; copied item/permission options vary. Project existence alone is not evidence the full template was reproduced.

capabilities.verification: Read latest update and full history with dates/status; inspect header and subscriber behavior.
capabilities.limitations: Project write to publish, read to view/subscribe; templates cannot have updates. Project-wide health is distinct from an item Status field; inspect current GraphQL schema before using mutation names.

operations: Link Project to repositories and teams
capabilities.verification: Read permission/visibility settings and verify with an appropriately scoped reader.
capabilities.limitations: Project admin/owner controls; a public Project never grants access to private repository issues. Access changes need explicit owner authorization; do not infer exposure from one privileged token.

capabilities.verification: Read discussion/category/comment node IDs and rendered state.
capabilities.limitations: Discussions repository permission and role apply; organization discussions use a chosen source repository. GraphQL is primary content API; gh api graphql works without inventing native gh discussion commands.

capabilities.verification: Read answerChosenAt/answer node and thread structure; verify selected answer belongs to correct discussion.
capabilities.limitations: Discussion author/maintainer rights differ; category must allow answers. Upvotes/reactions indicate feedback and are not review approvals or implementation acceptance.

operations: Pin/lock/transfer discussions and moderate disruptive content
Read poll options/vote counts and vote via addDiscussionPollVote; inspect upvote state with addUpvote/removeUpvote
capabilities.verification: Inspect category format/forms, pinned state, locks and transferred canonical URL.
capabilities.limitations: Maintainer/admin or moderation permissions; format-specific APIs may be read-only or absent. Poll/category management and transfer need operation-level schema check; do not substitute issue labels for Discussion categories. Poll voting has a documented GraphQL mutation; category/poll creation/configuration still requires operation-level inspection.

capabilities.capability: Wiki publishing and independent Git history
operations: Create first page via UI if necessary
Read page revision history and revert with new commit
capabilities.verification: Read remote Wiki commit with ls-remote and open published page; compare rendered content and links.
capabilities.limitations: Public Free/private paid plans; Wiki edit policy and repository write apply. Wiki is separate Git repository, not wiki/ source directory; no supported general-purpose Wiki content REST API established.

capabilities.capability: Wiki sidebar, footer, assets and navigation
capabilities.verification: Open Home and each changed navigation target; inspect image URLs and remote commit.
capabilities.limitations: Pull before edits; Wiki markup/page naming can change link resolution. Wiki does not inherit the main repository PR/branch-protection workflow automatically; publishing source is a separate write.

capabilities.verification: Record query, time, result count, incomplete_results and retrieved IDs; partition above result cap.
capabilities.limitations: Search has separate rate limits and up-to-1000-result windows; indexing and incomplete results make empty search insufficient proof of absence. Code search authentication/indexing restrictions differ from ordinary repository read.

capabilities.capability: Code search versus local source inspection
operations: Use path/repo/language/symbol/content and regular-expression UI qualifiers
Use REST code search supported syntax
Inspect Git at an exact ref for complete verification
capabilities.verification: Open matching file at immutable SHA and reproduce critical search locally.
capabilities.limitations: New web code search and REST code search are distinct engines; regex/symbol qualifiers are not automatically available through REST. Ignored/unindexed/generated/large files may require Git inspection.

capabilities.verification: Sample results and verify qualifiers against source objects and current identity.
capabilities.limitations: Global search, repository advanced filters and Project filters differ; requested-reviewer results change after review. Quote multiword values; do not mistake missing results for no permission-restricted work.

capabilities.verification: Read thread subscription and notification state using same user; preserve before/after timestamps.
capabilities.limitations: User-specific notifications are not a repository audit feed. Classic/OAuth notification scopes apply; fine-grained/App token support differs by endpoint. Marking done/read or ignoring is an external user-state write, not passive discovery.

operations: Configure custom watch events in UI
capabilities.verification: Read subscription/subscribed/ignored state and selected event preferences.
capabilities.limitations: Authenticated user controls personal state; App/fine-grained compatibility varies. Watching can create substantial notifications; do not subscribe or star silently as setup.

capabilities.verification: Record event IDs/timestamps and confirm consequential facts on owning issue/PR/commit API.
capabilities.limitations: Feeds have retention, latency and pagination limits and are not complete audit logs. Use enterprise/org audit log where authorized for security evidence.

capabilities.capability: Reuse owner issue fields in Projects
operations: Attach an owner issue field using createProjectV2IssueField
Read shared values rather than maintain duplicate custom fields
capabilities.verification: Compare issue field ID/value and Project issue-field binding on the same issue.
capabilities.limitations: Project write plus issue-field visibility/access; owner issue fields and Project-only fields have different lifetimes. Do not create a duplicate Priority field before checking the existing owner field.

operations: Write only when current field-value input supports the operation
capabilities.verification: Read field data type, option IDs and resulting item selections.
capabilities.limitations: Project permissions; schema/API-version support differs. Preserve existing selection IDs; do not coerce a multi-select into single-select or assume all gh project commands expose it.

capabilities.verification: Read comment ID/body/commit SHA and any line anchor.
capabilities.limitations: Contents read for discovery; endpoint-specific Contents write for creation and ownership/role for edits. Commit comments are distinct from PR conversation and review comments; validate line anchors on the referenced commit.

operations: Create branch linked to issue using createLinkedBranch
capabilities.verification: Read issue linkedBranches and actual ref SHA; confirm association removal leaves intended branch/content intact.
capabilities.limitations: Repository content/issue access and actor eligibility apply. A linked branch is distinct from a closing PR reference; unlinking does not establish issue completion or safe branch deletion.

operations: Set issue status with setIssueStatus including duplicate issue where applicable
capabilities.verification: Read status ID plus issue state/stateReason and duplicate relation after transition.
capabilities.limitations: Preview enrollment required; unavailable can return null. Distinct from Project item Status and open/closed state, but status transitions can close/reopen the issue. Discover valid IDs instead of hard-coding status names.

operations: Mark/unmark a file as viewed using markFileAsViewed/unmarkFileAsViewed
capabilities.verification: Read exact file path and viewed state as the same viewer on current PR head.
capabilities.limitations: Authenticated viewer state; marking viewed is not a submitted review or proof the file is correct. File changes can invalidate prior viewed state; do not mark unrelated files as reviewed.

capabilities.verification: Read resulting PR archived/state fields and timeline; inspect any lock changes on current host.
capabilities.limitations: Triage role or higher; host/version eligibility applies. Archiving closes a PR and differs from deleting branches, repository archival, or Project item archival; unarchiving is not necessarily reopening.

capabilities.capability: Hide and restore off-topic or disruptive comments
capabilities.verification: Read minimized state/reason and rendered comment visibility.
capabilities.limitations: Role and comment-type restrictions apply across issue/commit/PR/gist comments. Minimization preserves content and differs from deletion or locking; do not hide technical disagreement solely because it blocks delivery.

operations: Choose eligible contributor class and duration
capabilities.verification: Read limit class, expiry and owner scope; verify effective repository restriction without disruptive test posts.
capabilities.limitations: Organization owner/repository admin or personal-account ownership as applicable. Restricts real contributors and can affect multiple repositories; choose narrow authorized scope. Owner-wide restrictions and blocked-user lists are separate controls.

capabilities.capability: Personal saved replies and reusable response insertion
capabilities.verification: Reload saved reply settings and preview inserted draft; posting requires separate authorized comment write.
capabilities.limitations: Personal-account feature, up to 100 replies. No stable public CRUD API verified; saved replies do not authorize sending messages. Preserve existing replies and avoid adding sensitive project details to reusable text.

capabilities.verification: Read status and expiresAt as the user; inspect public or organization-scoped rendering.
capabilities.limitations: Current-user authorization and organization membership apply; personal user state is separate from account bio and issue/project status. Respect chosen visibility and avoid announcing availability changes without authorization.

operations: Read user lists and repository membership
Assign/remove repository from lists with updateUserListsForItem
capabilities.verification: Read list IDs/name/description and intended repository membership.
capabilities.limitations: Authenticated personal-account feature; starring and list membership are different operations. Use IDs, preserve other memberships, and inspect current visibility limits before storing private planning notes in list descriptions.

capabilities.capability: Personal profile README, pins and contribution display
operations: Configure contribution/private-profile display and achievements where supported
capabilities.verification: Open profile as intended audience and verify README, pins and contribution visibility.
capabilities.limitations: Account owner and Contents write for profile repository. Public README/pins expose chosen content; REST profile update does not configure these surfaces. Pins/display settings need UI unless current API explicitly supports them.

capabilities.verification: Read viewerIsFollowing or matching followed-organization relation as same user.
capabilities.limitations: Personal social state; host/preview availability varies. Following organization differs from joining it or watching all its repositories and does not grant access or membership.

operations: Configure profile and fiscal-host details through supported setup
capabilities.verification: Read listing and setup/published eligibility state.
capabilities.limitations: Eligible personal/organization account and Sponsors enrollment required; country/fiscal-host verification applies. Listing creation does not complete financial onboarding or publish approved payment details.

operations: Configure one-time/monthly amounts, description and repository-access benefit in UI
capabilities.verification: Read tier amount/recurrence/publication/retired state and benefit access rules.
capabilities.limitations: Sponsors maintainer/organization authority required. Paid tiers and repository benefits affect billing/access; retired tiers can retain existing sponsors. Preserve current subscribers; do not interpret retirement as cancellation.

operations: Create one or bulk sponsorships via createSponsorship/createSponsorships
capabilities.verification: Read sponsor/sponsorable/tier/amount/recurrence and each bulk result separately.
capabilities.limitations: Financial commitment requires explicit scope/amount/payer authorization, valid payment method and account eligibility. A partial bulk result is not all-or-nothing; cancellation and failed writes need read-back before retry.

capabilities.capability: Sponsorship privacy and connected platform preferences
operations: Manage Patreon sponsorability linkage using documented mutation
capabilities.verification: Read updated preference and relevant public/private relationship.
capabilities.limitations: Sponsor/maintainer authority and linked-platform eligibility apply. Privacy changes can publish sponsor identity; platform connection is not equivalent to a completed sponsorship or payment authorization.

capabilities.capability: Sponsor activity, lifetime value and exports
operations: Read sponsorships/sponsors/activity and permitted lifetime value
Export CSV/JSON within supported time windows
capabilities.verification: Reconcile date window/currency/account and exported rows against dashboard totals.
capabilities.limitations: Sponsors owner/admin and visibility scopes required. Export can trigger email delivery and contains financial/personal data; initiating delivery needs explicit authorization. Export is not proof all payments settled.

operations: Select tiers and publish to opted-in recipients when explicitly requested
capabilities.verification: Read sent update/target tiers and published history; distinguish draft from sent update.
capabilities.limitations: Sponsors owner/admin; opt-in recipient policy applies. Publishing sends email and requires explicit instruction to message recipients; listing management or repository setup alone does not authorize newsletters.

operations: Inspect payout history and payment holds
capabilities.verification: Match account/currency/date and receipt to payout history; report pending versus paid accurately.
capabilities.limitations: Financial identity/account-owner access and supported payout-provider/country rules apply. Banking/tax updates require owner handling; never infer payout completion from sponsorship creation or an API listing.

operations: Update or remove goal through supported UI
capabilities.verification: Read displayed goal and progress on intended Sponsors profile.
capabilities.limitations: Sponsors maintainer authority; public presentation and financial target are owner decisions. Goal progress is not recognized revenue and should not replace transaction/payout evidence.

operations: Read/create/edit/delete .github/workflows/*.yml through Git commits or Contents API; inspect events, inputs, matrices, services, containers, permissions, timeouts and concurrency
List/get workflows; enable/disable; dispatch workflow_dispatch with ref and typed inputs
surfaces: gh workflow list/view/run/enable/disable; repository Actions tab
capabilities.verification: Read committed YAML and workflow state; locate dispatched run by workflow/ref/event/SHA and inspect conclusion.
capabilities.limitations: Actions read/write permissions vary by operation. Workflow file writes require Contents and appropriate Workflows permission; dispatch must be configured and present on default branch. Dispatch acceptance is not execution success.

capabilities.capability: Workflow runs, attempts and execution control
operations: List/filter runs and attempts; read head SHA, event, status, conclusion and referenced workflows
Re-run all/failed jobs or one job and dependent jobs; enable debug; cancel/force cancel; delete runs
capabilities.verification: Match current attempt, head_sha and required checks; record final conclusion and run URL.
capabilities.limitations: Actions read for inspection, write for control. Re-running may execute code and spend resources; deleted runs/logs cannot prove prior results.

operations: List jobs per run or attempt; inspect steps, runner assignment and timestamps
Download job, step, run and attempt logs; delete run logs
surfaces: gh run view RUN --job JOB --log; gh run view RUN --log-failed
capabilities.verification: Inspect actual failed step and current attempt; retain redacted evidence and log expiration status.
capabilities.limitations: Actions read; write for log deletion. Download redirects expire. Logs may contain secrets; redact output and do not treat masking as a complete security boundary.

operations: List repository/run artifacts; inspect digest, expiration, size and associated run; download ZIP; delete
Upload/download in workflow with supported actions; set retention
surfaces: gh run download; actions/upload-artifact and actions/download-artifact
capabilities.verification: Download intended run artifact, verify digest and archive contents, check expired=false.
capabilities.limitations: Actions read/write; retention/storage limits apply. REST management is not an arbitrary artifact-upload API; workflow artifact upload uses Actions tooling.

operations: List by key/ref; inspect last access, size and usage; delete by ID/key
Get/set cache retention/storage limits at documented repository, organization or enterprise scope; inspect organization usage per repository
surfaces: GET/PUT .../actions/cache/retention-limit and /storage-limit where documented; organization /organizations/{org}/actions/cache equivalents; enterprise /enterprises/{enterprise}/actions/cache equivalents
capabilities.verification: Read limits/usage after write; inspect a real cache restore/save in workflow logs.
capabilities.limitations: Write/admin permissions depend on scope and limit endpoint; inherited limits and billing apply. Cache is untrusted reusable input, not a release artifact or secret store.

operations: List/set/add/remove selected repository access for organization variables; inspect inherited organization variables
capabilities.verification: Read effective scope, value and repository selection; verify vars consumption in the intended job.
capabilities.limitations: Variables are plaintext configuration. Variables read/write and environment/organization administrative authority depend on endpoint; plan and visibility affect organization access.

operations: List/get metadata; encrypt and create/update using scope public key; delete
Manage organization secret visibility and selected repositories; list inherited organization secrets
surfaces: gh secret list/set/delete --repo/--org/--env; set via stdin or secure file
capabilities.verification: Read metadata and selected repositories; use a minimal authorized workflow without echoing secret values.
capabilities.limitations: Secret values cannot be retrieved. Use Secrets read/write or scope-specific authority. Forks and Dependabot have distinct secret contexts; environment secrets require the environment gate. Never put plaintext secrets in issues, logs or command arguments.

capabilities.capability: Actions access, allowed actions and default token policy
operations: Get/set organization/repository Actions enabled state, allowed actions/reusable workflows, selected repositories, workflow-token default permissions and PR creation/approval policy
Configure sharing of private reusable actions/workflows and organization self-hosted runner access
surfaces: Settings > Actions > General; workflow/job permissions YAML
capabilities.verification: Re-read policy and inherited constraints; inspect actual GITHUB_TOKEN permissions in run setup.
capabilities.limitations: Administration or organization Actions permissions apply. Repository policy cannot loosen enterprise/organization restrictions. Keep read-only defaults and grant individual write permissions only for needed jobs.

capabilities.capability: Fork-run approvals and artifact/log retention policies
operations: Get/set fork PR contributor approval and private-fork workflow settings
Get/set organization/repository artifact-and-log retention; inspect approval history and approve eligible fork run
capabilities.verification: Read persisted settings; inspect approval actor and subsequent run with intended token/secret scope.
capabilities.limitations: Admin/policy rights and plan restrictions apply. Approval executes contributed code; inspect changes first. Never use pull_request_target to execute untrusted PR code with privileged secrets.

operations: List/get/create/update/delete repository and organization policy objects using documented rule schema
capabilities.verification: Read returned policy, target scope and inheritance; check its effect in a relevant run.
capabilities.limitations: Policy administration permission and current rollout apply. This is separate from the established Actions permissions endpoints; do not invent rule fields or assume a GHES version supports it.

operations: Configure workflow/job concurrency groups and cancellation behavior
List repository/run concurrency groups; inspect one group
capabilities.verification: Compare configured group with observed pending/running work and cancellation conclusions.
capabilities.limitations: Inspection requires Actions read; changes go through workflow YAML. Do not assume a group cancellation mutation exists; cancel the identified runs via run API.

operations: Create workflow_call inputs/secrets/outputs; invoke reusable workflow at job level; maintain shared workflow templates and composite/container/JavaScript action metadata
Pin caller uses to reviewed SHA; configure sharing; inspect called workflow references and permission propagation
capabilities.verification: Run a real caller and verify inputs, outputs, called SHA, runner and least-privilege token.
capabilities.limitations: Nested workflows cannot elevate token permissions. Caller/called repositories must be accessible and allowed by policy; environment secrets and caller env do not automatically pass as workflow secrets/env.

capabilities.capability: OIDC cloud identity and subject customization
operations: Get/set repository/organization OIDC subject template; list/create/delete organization/enterprise custom property inclusion
Configure id-token: write and cloud trust for exact repository/ref/environment or workflow identity
surfaces: Workflow YAML and cloud-provider IAM configuration
capabilities.verification: Verify non-sensitive token claims and a narrowly scoped cloud operation from intended job/environment.
capabilities.limitations: GitHub subject-template admin rights do not configure cloud IAM. id-token: write permits token issuance, not resource access. Changing subject shape can break existing trust; never print the JWT.

operations: List/get runners, OS, online/busy state, applications and version EOL; issue registration/removal tokens or JIT configuration; remove runner
List/add/set/remove labels; configure ephemeral process and runner host
surfaces: Organization /orgs/{org}/actions/runners equivalents; Settings > Actions > Runners; runner config/run scripts
capabilities.verification: Read online/label state and execute a harmless job on intended isolated runner; inspect cleanup.
capabilities.limitations: Administration or organization Self-hosted runners permissions; registration tokens are sensitive and temporary. API registration does not provision hardware or isolate untrusted workloads.

operations: Manage selected repository access and runner membership; inspect hosted runners in group and selected workflow restrictions
surfaces: .../{runner_group_id}/repositories and /runners; organization Settings > Actions > Runner groups
capabilities.verification: Re-read membership, visibility and allowed workflows; verify target repository can schedule an intended job.
capabilities.limitations: Organization authority and runner-group plan availability apply; inherited enterprise groups may be read-only. Group membership alone does not establish secure host isolation.

capabilities.capability: Managed larger runners, machine types and custom images
operations: List/create/get/update/delete configured hosted runners; inspect platforms, sizes, image choices and limits
List/get/delete custom image definitions/versions; build new images using documented image workflow
capabilities.verification: Read persisted runner/image version and run a representative job on the selected runner.
capabilities.limitations: Organization runner-management authority; supported paid plans, metered compute, platform and region limits. Custom image API management does not imply a generic image-upload endpoint.

capabilities.capability: Environments, protection gates and branch/tag policies
operations: List/get/create/update/delete environments; configure reviewers, wait timers, self-review prevention and bypass policy
List/create/update/delete deployment branch/tag policies; list/enable/disable custom GitHub App protection rules
capabilities.verification: Re-read environment and rules; inspect a real job blocked/allowed by intended gate.
capabilities.limitations: Repository Administration read/write. Public repositories support environments across current plans; private/internal require an eligible paid plan. Reviewer/wait/custom-rule availability is narrower; inspect exact plan before promising support.

capabilities.capability: Pending deployments and custom protection decisions
operations: List pending deployments and review history; approve/reject eligible environments with reason
Submit custom protection-rule result using the authorized GitHub App integration
capabilities.verification: Read approval actor/reason and subsequent job/deployment conclusion.
capabilities.limitations: Reviewer eligibility and prevent-self-review rules apply. Custom rule review must use authorized integration; an agent must not impersonate an independent required reviewer.

operations: List/get/create/delete deployments for ref, task and environment
Create/list/get deployment statuses with state, log/environment URLs, inactive/production flags
surfaces: Repository deployments UI; actual deployment engine/cloud CLI separately
capabilities.verification: Match deployment SHA/environment; inspect final status and visit deployed application with a meaningful health check.
capabilities.limitations: Deployments read/write; inactive-state deletion constraints apply. A deployment API record does not execute a deployment; success status alone is not application verification.

capabilities.capability: Repository security products and reporting policy
operations: Inspect/update security_and_analysis, vulnerability-alert and automated-security-fixes settings; enable private vulnerability reporting where supported
Maintain SECURITY.md and security reporting route; inspect inherited organization configuration
surfaces: GET/PUT/DELETE .../private-vulnerability-reporting; Git SECURITY.md; Settings > Code security
capabilities.verification: Read actual settings using eligible token; verify SECURITY.md rendered and private report entry point.
capabilities.limitations: Administration/security-manager authority; public/free and private paid Code Security/Secret Protection eligibility differ. SECURITY.md is policy text and does not enable scanning.

operations: List/get/create/update/delete configurations; inspect defaults; attach/detach repositories; set defaults
Select dependency graph/submission, Dependabot, Code Security, Secret Protection, reporting, delegated dismissal/bypass, validity/metadata and enforcement options
capabilities.verification: Read configuration, associated repository application status and effective settings; asynchronous attachment must complete.
capabilities.limitations: Organization owner/security manager and Administration permission. Product licenses and enterprise policy constrain options; enabling paid products may consume licenses. Prefer individual code_security and secret_protection fields over deprecated combined values.

capabilities.capability: CodeQL setup, databases and variant analyses

List/download/delete language databases; create/read variant analysis and per-repository result
capabilities.verification: Verify intended SHA/language/query suite produced a completed analysis.
capabilities.limitations: Security events/administrative rights; Code Security entitlement for private repositories. Default/advanced setup and language support constrain configuration.

capabilities.capability: Code scanning alerts, analyses and SARIF
operations: List/filter/get/update alerts and instances; dismiss/reopen with reason; list/get/delete analyses
capabilities.verification: Match processed SARIF/analysis to commit and tool; re-read alert state.
capabilities.limitations: Code scanning alerts read/write; SARIF validation/size limits and enabled product required. Accepted upload is not completed analysis.

operations: Read/update organization/repository AI Scan enablement where available
capabilities.verification: Inspect generated diff; run tests and re-scan.
capabilities.limitations: Product entitlement, policy, supported alert/language and extra commit permissions apply. Generated fixes require review; API presence does not guarantee account availability.

operations: Inspect dependency changes between base/head, vulnerabilities and licensing
Submit dependency snapshots for dependencies missing from supported manifests; configure automatic submission where supported
surfaces: Dependency review Action; Insights > Dependency graph; PR dependency review
capabilities.verification: Match resolved dependency diff/snapshot to commit and ecosystem; inspect review check.
capabilities.limitations: Dependency review private repositories requires eligible Code Security plan; graph must be enabled. Submission uses Contents write; incomplete manifests/build resolution produce incomplete inventory.

operations: Export current dependency graph as SPDX SBOM
Request asynchronous report generation and fetch by returned UUID where available
capabilities.verification: Parse returned SPDX; inspect repository identity, generation time, package versions and coverage.
capabilities.limitations: Repository read/Contents read as documented; graph coverage bounds SBOM completeness. An SBOM is inventory, not a clean vulnerability scan or provenance attestation.

operations: List/get/filter alerts at repository/organization/enterprise scope; dismiss/reopen with documented reason
Inspect reachability/EPSS where returned; enable security updates and review remediation PRs
surfaces: Organization/enterprise Dependabot alerts routes; repository automated-security-fixes endpoint; Security > Dependabot
capabilities.verification: Re-read alert state; verify lockfile upgrade, passing PR checks and resolved alert after merge.
capabilities.limitations: Dependabot alerts read/write; organization/enterprise visibility limited by role. API documented as public preview. Dismissal does not remediate a vulnerability; update availability depends on ecosystem and fix.

operations: Create/edit dependabot.yml for ecosystem, directories, schedule, groups/multi-ecosystem groups, allow/ignore, cooldowns, registries, labels/assignees/reviewers and target branch where supported
Inspect update jobs/logs; trigger manual update and supported @dependabot PR commands
surfaces: Dependabot PR comments for documented rebase/recreate commands; PR APIs
capabilities.verification: Read default-branch config; inspect actual update job and generated PR for each intended ecosystem.
capabilities.limitations: Per-ecosystem option support differs. Do not invent a generic REST create-version-update job endpoint. Version updates differ from vulnerability-triggered security updates; maintain both explicitly.

operations: List/get metadata, encrypt/create/update/delete repository/organization Dependabot secrets
Manage organization secret repository access and configure private registry references
surfaces: gh secret --app dependabot list/set/delete; dependabot.yml registries
capabilities.verification: Read secret metadata and repository selection; inspect authorized registry resolution without logging credentials.
capabilities.limitations: Dependabot secrets permissions; distinct from Actions secrets and unavailable for plaintext retrieval. Organization private repository access and plan restrictions apply.

capabilities.capability: Dependabot runner and private repository access settings
operations: Read/set standard or labeled runner settings, labels and runner group
List/update organization/enterprise repository access list and default access level
capabilities.verification: Read effective runner settings and inspect dependency-update job on intended runner; check allowed private repository dependency resolution.
capabilities.limitations: Labeled runners only take effect for private/internal repositories with Actions enabled. Repository-access management has separate owner/token requirements; inspect its official endpoint documentation before writes.

capabilities.capability: Secret scanning alerts, locations and scan history
operations: List/get/filter alerts and locations; resolve/reopen with documented reason; inspect validity and push-protection context
Inspect repository scan history; enable scanning through repository security settings
surfaces: GET .../secret-scanning/scan-history; organization alerts endpoint; Settings > Code security
capabilities.verification: Re-read alert/resolution; verify leaked credentials revoked with provider and inspect relevant scan coverage.
capabilities.limitations: Secret scanning alerts read/write and product eligibility. Responses can include secret values; redact them. Resolving an alert never revokes a credential.

operations: Inspect/enable repository push protection, delegated bypass and dismissal policy
Use documented bypass request/review path only for explicitly authorized false positive/test secret; inspect pattern configurations
capabilities.verification: Read policy and actual reviewed bypass record; test safe non-sensitive detection only when authorized.
capabilities.limitations: Secret Protection/plan and delegated reviewer eligibility apply. User-level push protection differs from repository-level scanning. Never bypass a real leaked secret to make a push succeed.

capabilities.capability: Secret custom patterns and validity controls
operations: List/create/update/delete organization/repository custom patterns through documented bulk APIs
Configure push-protection participation; use supported dry-run/publish and validity/metadata settings
surfaces: GET/POST/DELETE /orgs/{org}/secret-scanning/custom-patterns and repository counterparts; PATCH .../custom-patterns/{pattern_id}; Settings > Code security > Secret scanning
Organization security configurations for validity, extended metadata and generic/AI pattern options
capabilities.verification: Inspect returned pattern IDs/version and test safe positive/negative examples; verify published detection.
capabilities.limitations: Pattern and product permissions apply; some controls require UI or current schema-specific endpoints. Extended metadata requires validity checks. Do not send live credentials as pattern test samples.

capabilities.capability: Repository advisories, private reports and coordinated disclosure
operations: List/get/create/update advisories, draft/publish/withdraw where allowed; privately report vulnerabilities
Read/create/edit comments; create temporary private fix fork; request CVE
surfaces: Advisory comment routes; organization advisory listing; Security > Advisories
capabilities.verification: Read advisory state, vulnerable/fixed ranges, collaborators, CVE and publication URL; verify fix release exists.
capabilities.limitations: Repository security advisory permission and collaborator role govern confidential data; private reporting must be enabled. Publishing discloses details publicly; scope authorization separately from drafting.

operations: Search/filter/list reviewed and unreviewed advisories; get GHSA details and affected package versions
surfaces: GET /advisories; GET /advisories/{ghsa_id}; GitHub Advisory Database UI
capabilities.verification: Match ecosystem/package/version and patched range to actual dependency graph.
capabilities.limitations: Lookup is evidence, not an exploitability assessment; absent advisory does not establish safety. Respect pagination and update timestamps.

capabilities.capability: Security coverage, campaigns, bypass and dismissal review
operations: Inspect organization security coverage/risk and prioritize alerts; manage delegated review where the account exposes it
Track fixes via issues/PRs and re-read security state
surfaces: Organization Security > Overview; security configurations and documented product APIs
UI for campaign/delegated-review controls without a verified public mutation; export available reports
capabilities.verification: Record account-visible coverage/review and individual resolved findings, including exclusions.
capabilities.limitations: Organization security-manager rights and product/preview availability. Do not claim every UI control has REST/GraphQL write support; record unsupported mutations as UI handoff.

capabilities.capability: Drafts, publication, prereleases and generated notes
operations: List/get latest/by-tag releases; create draft, edit title/body/target, publish, mark prerelease/latest, delete where allowed
Generate notes and maintain .github/release.yml categorization; link discussion category where supported
surfaces: gh release list/view/create/edit/delete; git tags; Releases UI
capabilities.verification: Read published release, exact tag/commit, draft/prerelease/latest state and release notes; compare version source.
capabilities.limitations: Contents write and repository policy; release creation can create a tag. A Git tag and a GitHub Release are distinct. Published latest excludes drafts/prereleases by semantics; do not infer from sorted tags.

operations: Inspect digest/content type/size and exact archive contents before publication
surfaces: POST returned upload_url on uploads.github.com with binary body and name; gh release upload/download/delete-asset
capabilities.verification: Download published bytes and verify expected checksum/content/version; re-read asset metadata and download URL.
capabilities.limitations: Contents read/write. Asset uploads are separate from creating release; partial uploads need reconciliation. Immutable published releases prohibit asset modification/deletion.

operations: Enable repository or organization immutability policy for future releases; create draft, attach complete assets, then publish
Verify release attestation/tag/assets; edit allowed title/notes/prerelease/latest metadata
surfaces: Repository Settings > General > Releases > Enable release immutability
Organization Settings > Repository > General > Releases; GET/PUT/DELETE /repos/{owner}/{repo}/immutable-releases; GET/PUT /orgs/{org}/settings/immutable-releases and selected repositories routes
gh release verify; gh release verify-asset; release immutable field/badge
capabilities.verification: Read immutable state; verify attestation, locked tag commit and downloaded asset digests.
capabilities.limitations: Only future releases are affected. Published tag/assets are protected; do not promise replacing assets or reusing protected tag names. Confirm installed gh supports verification commands; policy configuration UI is the documented fallback.

operations: Generate signed provenance/SBOM attestations in Actions; associate Sigstore bundle with repository
Get/download attestations by subject digest; verify binary or OCI image against expected repo/workflow/identity
surfaces: actions/attest or documented provenance/SBOM Actions; workflow id-token: write and attestations: write
POST /repos/{owner}/{repo}/attestations; GET .../attestations/{subject_digest}; organization/user digest lookup routes
gh attestation download/verify/trusted-root; OCI registry digest
capabilities.verification: Verify downloaded bytes/digest, certificate identity, workflow/ref and transparency/issuer policy, not merely bundle presence.
capabilities.limitations: Public repositories on current plans; private/internal need Enterprise Cloud. Creating needs repository write/Attestations write; OIDC is needed for workflow identity. Provenance is not a vulnerability guarantee.

operations: List/get packages and versions by organization/user; inspect metadata/digests
Delete/restore packages or versions where supported; inspect migration conflicts if relevant
surfaces: DELETE package/version route; POST .../restore; package settings UI
capabilities.verification: Read version/digest/visibility and test installation before declaring delivery; verify deletion or restoration state.
capabilities.limitations: Management REST requires documented classic PAT scopes; GITHUB_TOKEN has supported package workflow exceptions. Admin permission required for destructive operations; retention/restoration limits and download-count safeguards apply.

operations: Build and publish/install OCI/container, npm, RubyGems, Maven/Gradle and NuGet packages with ecosystem tools
Configure namespace, package/repository link, immutable version/digest and workflow package permissions
surfaces: docker/podman for ghcr.io; npm for npm.pkg.github.com; gem for rubygems.pkg.github.com; mvn/gradle for maven.pkg.github.com; dotnet nuget for nuget.pkg.github.com
Workflow GITHUB_TOKEN with packages permissions or authorized classic PAT; ecosystem auth configuration
capabilities.verification: Install/pull exact published version/digest from a clean consumer and run a meaningful smoke check.
capabilities.limitations: Supported registries differ by host/plan. REST package metadata management is not a generic publishing API. Never expose registry tokens in source/config logs; storage/data-transfer billing applies.

capabilities.capability: Package visibility, linked repository and access control
operations: Inspect/configure granular user/team/repository access, inherited repository access, Actions/Codespaces access, visibility and linked repository
surfaces: Package page > Package settings > Manage access/Actions/Codespaces access; organization Settings > Packages
OCI org.opencontainers.image.source or ecosystem repository metadata for package linkage
capabilities.verification: Inspect effective package ACL and test consumer/workflow access using intended principal.
capabilities.limitations: Registry permissions differ: granular versus repository-scoped. Public repository does not necessarily make its package public. Visibility transitions and inherited ACL have restrictions; unverified UI mutations remain handoff.

capabilities.capability: Pages source, custom domain, TLS and visibility
operations: Get/create/update/delete site; choose branch/path or Actions build source; set custom domain/HTTPS where supported
Inspect DNS health; configure domain verification/DNS and access policy through authorized owning service
surfaces: Settings > Pages; Git CNAME for applicable source; DNS provider and owner verified-domain settings
capabilities.verification: Read site source/domain/HTTPS state and DNS health; request public/authorized URL and verify content, certificate and redirects.
capabilities.limitations: Pages permissions plus repository admin/Contents rights for some writes. Private repository source does not guarantee a private site; private publishing/access control requires eligible Enterprise Cloud configuration.

operations: List/get/request legacy Pages builds and inspect latest status
Upload Pages artifact in Actions; create/get/cancel Pages deployment; inspect environment status and deployed SHA
capabilities.verification: Require completed build/deployment for intended SHA and inspect rendered site/assets at site URL.
capabilities.limitations: Workflow deploy needs pages: write and id-token: write plus environment policy. Accepted deployment is not live success; custom workflow artifacts must satisfy Pages packaging constraints.

operations: List/get/create/update/delete published campaigns; configure managers/teams, deadline, contact and code scanning alert selection; optionally generate issues
Use UI for draft campaigns and inspect remediation progress
capabilities.verification: Read campaign state, managers, deadline and alert counts; confirm actual alert remediation and generated issues.
capabilities.limitations: Organization owner/security manager; Campaigns read/write and Code scanning alerts read for included repositories. Draft campaigns cannot be read or managed through these REST endpoints; product eligibility applies.

operations: List/filter/get findings; inspect locations, rules and severity
Get/update setup configuration through documented schema; verify intended analysis coverage
capabilities.verification: Read configured setup and findings for intended revision; inspect resulting analysis/checks.
capabilities.limitations: Use endpoint-specific Code quality permissions and current product eligibility. Findings API is read-only; do not invent finding-dismissal or fix-commit mutation from code scanning equivalents.

capabilities.capability: Linked artifact storage and deployment metadata
operations: Record artifact storage/deployment information keyed by digest; list known records
Set cluster deployment records directly or create asynchronous cluster records job and poll status
capabilities.verification: Read digest-associated records and completed job; cross-check actual registry bytes and deployed workload digest.
capabilities.limitations: Repository Artifact metadata permission and linked-artifact product/rollout eligibility. Metadata does not push a binary or deploy it; only record actual observed storage/deployment facts.

capabilities.capability: Check runs, output annotations and requested actions
operations: List runs by ref/suite; get run and paginated annotations; create/update run name, head SHA, state/conclusion, details URL, output, images and requested-action buttons
Append line annotations in batches; rerequest run and handle check_run webhook requested_action/rerequested
surfaces: GraphQL CheckRun/CheckAnnotation; createCheckRun and updateCheckRun; gh api; PR Checks tab
capabilities.verification: Read run head_sha, owning App, conclusion, output and annotation locations; verify execution independently before reporting success.
capabilities.limitations: Checks read/write and operation-specific App/token eligibility. Creation requires GitHub App identity; do not infer create rights from a token that can rerequest. Maximum 50 annotations per request; updates append. Rerequest emits event and does not itself update the run. Never manufacture passing checks.

operations: List/get suites for Git ref and associated runs; inspect App, branch, SHA, status and conclusion
Create suite where manual flow is needed; update automatic suite-creation preferences by App; rerequest suite
surfaces: GraphQL Commit.checkSuites, CheckSuite.checkRuns; createCheckSuite, updateCheckSuitePreferences, rerequestCheckSuite
capabilities.verification: Inspect latest suite for intended SHA and actual constituent runs; after rerequest observe new execution and resulting conclusion.
capabilities.limitations: Checks read/write; suite creation is GitHub App-only; each operation lists supported token types. App ownership and repository push visibility apply. Fork-only pushes may return empty matching PR data. Rerequest queues an event, not successful execution.

capabilities.capability: Commit status contexts and combined check visibility
operations: Create pending/success/failure/error commit status with context, description and target URL; list history and combined latest state by ref
Inspect combined Checks and StatusContext rollup for exact PR head or merge-group SHA and compare required checks/rules
surfaces: GraphQL Commit.status and statusCheckRollup.contexts with CheckRun/StatusContext fragments; gh pr checks; PR checks UI
capabilities.verification: Read back latest status for the exact SHA/context and expected creator; inspect Checks separately and compare required-check source App where configured.
capabilities.limitations: Commit statuses read/write permission; checks are distinct objects and combined-status REST excludes check runs. Status creation appends history; there is no arbitrary status edit/delete API. A pending/success rollup is not independent proof that a required trusted check executed.

capabilities.capability: Trusted publishing to external package registries
operations: Configure a registry trusted publisher bound to GitHub repository/workflow and optional environment; grant job id-token: write and publish validated package without long-lived publishing token
Support PyPI trusted publishing and npm trusted publishers through their native registry configuration; inspect provenance, version and published bytes
surfaces: PyPI project Settings > Publishing; pypa/gh-action-pypi-publish; GitHub Actions release workflow and protected environment
npmjs.com package Settings > Trusted publishing; npm publish or supported npm trust CLI; https://docs.npmjs.com/trusted-publishers/
External registry-native API/UI; Git commits and Actions logs; no GitHub Packages trusted-publisher CRUD endpoint is implied
capabilities.verification: Read registry trust binding, run authorized release workflow, download/install exact published distribution and inspect registry provenance with intended repository/workflow identity.
capabilities.limitations: External registry package-owner authorization and current runner/CLI limits apply. npm trusted publishing currently requires supported cloud-hosted runners and modern npm/Node versions; install/private dependency access may still require separate credentials. Registry trust is not configured by editing GitHub YAML; GitHub Packages uses its documented authentication instead.

capabilities.capability: GitHub Agentic Workflows authoring and execution
operations: Author Markdown workflow with triggers, permissions, engine and safe outputs; compile .lock.yml and commit both files; import/update reviewed upstream workflow with source reference
Run workflow; inspect logs/audit/token usage and estimated inference cost; adjust prompts/configuration and recompile
surfaces: Git .github/workflows/NAME.md and NAME.lock.yml; gh extension install github/gh-aw when authorized
gh aw init/add/compile/run/logs/audit/update; GitHub Actions UI and standard run/job APIs
Supported Copilot/Codex/Claude/Gemini engine identity and secure credential setup; frontmatter permissions, safe outputs and network controls
capabilities.verification: Review compiled workflow and declared outputs; run a narrowly scoped task and inspect actual issue/PR/comment, run logs, safe-output decisions and cost.
capabilities.limitations: Requires Actions, repository write, installed gh aw and selected engine entitlement/credential; Actions and inference incur separate costs. Imports/initialization modify repository files and may create PRs; inspect first. Untrusted repository text remains untrusted; engine availability does not imply write authorization. GitHub Models is retired and is not this feature.

capabilities.verification: Read current object/list and effective inherited policy; for an authorized mutation read back exact IDs/fields and retain response evidence. Documentation inventory verified 2026-11-15 against official GitHub OpenAPI; no live write test.

capabilities.capability: Invitations, failed/pending invitations, membership roles and public membership
capabilities.verification: Read current object/list and effective inherited policy; for an authorized mutation read back exact IDs/fields and retain response evidence. Documentation inventory verified 2026-11-15 against official GitHub OpenAPI; no live write test.

Enterprise Managed Users use IdP provisioning rather than ordinary invitations. Removal revokes access; public-member lists are incomplete membership evidence.

capabilities.capability: Team lifecycle, hierarchy and repository access
capabilities.verification: Read current object/list and effective inherited policy; for an authorized mutation read back exact IDs/fields and retain response evidence. Documentation inventory verified 2026-11-15 against official GitHub OpenAPI; no live write test.
capabilities.limitations: Members read/write; repository grants additionally require appropriate repository Administration and authority. Prefer organization/slug routes over legacy numeric-team APIs. Secret-team visibility is restricted; inherited grants survive removing a direct grant.

capabilities.capability: Team member and maintainer roles and pending invitations
capabilities.verification: Read current object/list and effective inherited policy; for an authorized mutation read back exact IDs/fields and retain response evidence. Documentation inventory verified 2026-11-15 against official GitHub OpenAPI; no live write test.
capabilities.limitations: Members read/write; organization owner or permitted team maintainer. Identity-provider synchronized memberships cannot be treated as independent local grants.

capabilities.capability: List/remove external collaborators and convert members
capabilities.verification: Read current object/list and effective inherited policy; for an authorized mutation read back exact IDs/fields and retain response evidence. Documentation inventory verified 2026-11-15 against official GitHub OpenAPI; no live write test.
capabilities.limitations: Members read/write; organization owner for membership conversion/removal. Conversion can strip organization and team access; ordinary repository collaborator grants are a separate operation.

capabilities.verification: Read current object/list and effective inherited policy; for an authorized mutation read back exact IDs/fields and retain response evidence. Documentation inventory verified 2026-11-15 against official GitHub OpenAPI; no live write test.
capabilities.limitations: Custom organization roles read for role discovery; Members write for assignment; owners for writes. Custom-role creation and updates require Enterprise Cloud surfaces; built-in roles do not imply arbitrary custom permissions.

capabilities.capability: Custom repository roles and their definitions
capabilities.verification: Read current object/list and effective inherited policy; for an authorized mutation read back exact IDs/fields and retain response evidence. Documentation inventory verified 2026-11-15 against official GitHub OpenAPI; no live write test.
